verdict.rationale: Otter documents a scheduled AI notetaker that automatically joins Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet meetings. It also offers bot-free recording from the Mac/Windows desktop app and for impromptu Google Meet calls, plus automatic sync of Zoom cloud recordings, and hands-on users report recording all their work meetings with good accuracy. However, community reports of the bot auto-joining or rejoining meetings the user did not intend weaken the 'recording where I want it' element. Missing for 10: documented per-meeting or per-platform controls over when the bot joins, and independent corroboration of reliable Teams and Meet capture.

support.subject: As a product manager, the notetaker reliably captures Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams meetings, with recording where I want it

citations.quote: Schedule your AI Meeting Notetaker to automatically join all your Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet meetings.
Record conversations directly from your Mac or Windows desktop, without bots joining the call.
Capture impromptu Google Meet calls without a bot present
Automatic sync of cloud recordings from Zoom
